title: A 3/5/3 MACD through rise, reversal, and recovery

checkpoints.lesson: The oscillator exists, but the signal still needs three MACD observations.
This is the first fully ready 3/5/3 row.
MACD remains positive while the histogram turns negative: fast EMA is still above slow EMA, but MACD has fallen below its signal.
The MACD zero cross is exactly the fast/slow EMA cross.
Both spreads are positive again in this particular path.
